description: Look up a Sky High rental product by name. Returns the page URL, units in stock, how many times families have booked it, and price. ALWAYS pass event_date (and zip when you know it) - with a date this returns the EXACT price for that date and whether it is available, which you should quote directly. Prices returned here are LIVE - prefer them over any knowledge-file price, and never send the customer to the product page to find a price this tool can give you.

event_date.description: Event date YYYY-MM-DD. Always pass it when the customer has said their date - it returns the exact price for that day.

product_name.description: Product name or close description, e.g. 'Niagara water slide'

zip.description: 5-digit delivery zip, when known. Selects the right metro's pricing.

name: product_info
title: Look up a rental
